name: Path of Wild Magic
description: A barbarian subclass that adds the Wild Magic tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Magic Awareness
grants.description: As an Action, learn the location of spells and magic items within 60 feet that are not behind total cover, including each spell's school. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Wild Surge
grants.description: Whenever you enter Rage, roll on the Wild Magic table and apply that magical effect. If an effect calls for a save, it uses Constitution and your Proficiency Bonus.

grants.name: Bolstering Magic
grants.description: As an Action, touch a creature to grant either a 10-minute 1d3 bonus to attacks and ability checks or restore one expended spell slot whose level is no higher than a d3 roll. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.

grants.name: Unstable Backlash
grants.description: While raging, use your Reaction after taking damage or failing a saving throw to replace your current Wild Surge effect with a new roll.

grants.name: Controlled Surge
grants.description: When you roll on the Wild Magic table, roll twice and choose which result takes effect. Matching results let you choose any result on the table.
